about: Reviewed entries for production hunks that need one (class live, item or cfg-test-stmt), keyed by fingerprint (delta_inventory2.py). Each states its class and the evidence it is priced or allocation-free.

entries.evidence: Absent from every production build (`#[cfg(test)]`), and so from the profile, the pinned record and admission; also absent from the challenge's binary (tests/retained_memory_challenge.rs is an integration test, which links the lib without cfg(test)). Present only in the lib test binary, where the law tests and the S1 witnesses run with nothing armed. `ordinary_run_entered` (retained_tests_hooks/grant2.rs:57) clones the thread-local `TALLY` (grant2.rs:21: a const-initialized `RefCell<Option<Arc<Tally>>>`; the clone is a reference-count increment) and, only inside a test's `counted`, adds 1 to an `AtomicUsize`. With no tally it does nothing. No allocation, no text, no production type changes.
